# universal-actuator-mcp

> Industrial federation gateway — consolidates 15+ MCP servers into a single universal tool interface with RAG, fleet telemetry, and agentic workflows.

## Tools

- `universal_actuator(domain, action, ...)` — route actions to sub-servers (media/system/files)
- `universal_status()` — hub health, federation graph, registered domains
- `search_federated(query, sources)` — parallel search across calibre/plex/immich/docs/knowledge
- `rag_semantic_search(query)` — vector search over ingested fleet content
- `ingest_fleet_to_rag(source)` — bulk ingest from fleet nodes into LanceDB
- `glom_on(domain)` — auto-discover and attach a sub-server at runtime
- `get_fleet_telemetry()` — live telemetry from all sub-servers
- `universal_milestone(title, description)` — record milestone via Advanced Memory
- `agentic_workflow_tool(goal)` — autonomous 3-phase Plan→Execute→Audit
- `universal_shutdown()` — terminate the hub
